text:
maria: heads up — we pushed a BMC fw rewrite to eu-central1 rack-12 at 09:12UTC and now seeing ~12 nodes fail provisioning (PXE stalls, OOB console shows UEFI shell).
jonathan: on it, grabbing serials. which fw version was rolled?
maria: v2.0.7 -> v2.1.0 (security + nvram schema changes). deploy-bot: firmware-rewrite started for rack-12 (job/4832).
kevin: quick check — I can see NVRAM vars got reset on 8 hosts, SecureBoot variable now reports "Disabled" in efivar.
san: can you paste the console snippet?
kevin: paste: ```UEFI Interactive Shell v2.2
Shell> map -r
fs0:\> bcfg boot dump -v
Boot0001  Server PXE  HD(1,GPT,...)
No BootOrder entries match````
nana: looks like NVRAM GUID remap — nvram variables wiped, bootorder lost. that explains PXE stalls.
maria: are these reachable via IPMI? we need a quick remediation to restore boot order.
jonathan: yes, IPMI reachable. testing ipmitool to set UEFI variable: ```ipmitool -I lanplus -H $IP -U admin -P $PASS chassis bootdev pxe options=efiboot``` — will try on one node.
eng-oncall: please hold on mass changes, run on single node and confirm. also open a ticket to rollback fw if we can't patch variables.
kevin: succeeded on node eu-c12-node-07, boot to PXE after forcing efiboot. doing batch script now.
maria: good. can we automate restoring bootorder from template? we have a saved template in ops-runbooks:/runbooks/uefi-restore.json.
jonathan: batching via parallel ipmitool is slow; suggest using our oob-agent to push efivar restore (faster). but agent needs compatibility flag with v2.1.0 — currently failing.
sam: if agent incompatible, we can fallback to temporary netboot via internal rescue image to reprovision while we fix nvram. it's more costly (extra network egress + time). what's the cost impact?
maria: estimate ~3TB egress + extra node hours; ops-finance pinged for charge approval. not ideal.
nana: short-term plan: 1) run ipmitool efiboot fix on remaining 11 nodes (eng-oncall to coordinate), 2) hold further v2.1.0 rollouts in eu-central1, 3) prepare rollback package v2.0.7 if agent compatibility can't be restored by EOD.
eng-oncall: ack. i'll coordinate windows for ipmitool changes and document exactly which BMC macs to touch. tagging @kevin for runbook updates.
kevin: updating runbook now, adding `ipmitool` snippet and a small script: ```for i in $(cat nodes.txt); do ipmitool -I lanplus -H $i -U admin -P $PASS chassis bootdev pxe options=efiboot || echo $i >> failed.txt; done```
maria: keep me posted. if more than 20% of the rack fails after remediation we cut to rollback.
eng-oncall: rolling remediation started at 09:22UTC. current progress: 3/11 fixed. will post updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: firmware-rewrite job/4832 completed for rack-12 (success: 36, failed: 12).
jonathan: filing incident ticket with logs + serial dumps. I'll attach `journalctl -b` snippets and IPMI logs.
maria: thanks team. postmortem after stabilization.
eng-oncall: update 09:28UTC — 8/11 fixed, 3 remain, one node stuck in UEFI shell requiring manual nvram clear via serial. scheduling hands-on at 09:40UTC.
